g.text: The overall framework begins with the Deepfake Impersonation Attacker module.
The pipeline starts from the Attack Datasets.
The datasets feed into the Deepfake Video sequence.
Next, MTCNN is applied to crop faces from the video.
The attacker processes the extracted Celebrity Images.
The Attack Type is split into Targeted and Non-targeted pathways.
Both pathways lead to the Commercial Celebrity Recognition Web APIs.
These web APIs comprise Amazon Rekognition, Azure Cognitive Services, and Naver CFR.

text.tspan: Results are forwarded to the Evaluation module,
divided into Success Rate and API Result Analysis Metrics.

g.text: The Success Rate is evaluated across Targeted Attack and Non-targeted Attack scenarios.

text.tspan: Under the API Result Analysis Metrics, performance is assessed across Lifelike Deepfakes,
High Confidence Deepfakes, High Similarity Deepfakes, and Successfully Fooling the API.
